snippet.title: The Next Stop | English Trailer
snippet.description:
A dark narrative point-and-click game where every decision leaves its mark.

👁️‍🗨️ Explore disturbing scenarios, solve psychological puzzles, and face choices that reveal who you really are.
Inspired by titles such as Silent Hill: Shattered Memories, Fran Bow, and Night in the Woods.

💬 What did you think of the trailer? Tell us in the comments!
